tools.name: channelengine_list_channels
tools.description: List the marketplaces and webshops (channels) connected to this merchant account, with their ids. Good first call: channel ids are used by the other filters. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/channels.

tools.name: channelengine_get_settings
tools.description: Get the merchant account settings in ChannelEngine. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/settings.

tools.name: channelengine_list_stock_locations
tools.description: List the stock locations (warehouses) of this merchant account, with their ids. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/stocklocations.

tools.name: channelengine_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with filters: status, order numbers, channel, order date range and acknowledgement state. Returns Content plus TotalCount. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/orders.

tools.name: channelengine_get_new_orders
tools.description: Get the orders that are new and not yet processed by the merchant (the usual order-intake call). Merchant API: GET /api/v2/orders/new.

tools.name: channelengine_acknowledge_order
tools.description: WRITE: acknowledge one order, which tells the channel the merchant accepted it. Needs the ChannelEngine OrderId (from channelengine_list_orders). Optionally sets your own MerchantOrderNo on it. Merchant API: POST /api/v2/orders/acknowledge.

tools.name: channelengine_list_products
tools.description: Search the merchant product catalogue by name, merchant product number, EAN or brand, or by explicit lists of product numbers or EANs. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/products.

tools.name: channelengine_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its merchant product number (SKU). Merchant API: GET /api/v2/products/{merchantProductNo}.

tools.name: channelengine_list_channel_listings
tools.description: List the products listed on one channel (marketplace or webshop), optionally for given merchant product numbers. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/channels/{channelId}/products.

tools.name: channelengine_get_stock
tools.description: Get the stock level per product across all stock locations. Pages start at index 0 here. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/offer/stock.

tools.name: channelengine_update_stock
tools.description: WRITE: set the absolute stock for products at stock locations. This changes live stock on every connected channel. Send the full stock per location, not a change. Merchant API: PUT /api/v2/offer/stock.

tools.name: channelengine_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments created for merchant orders, with filters on order, shipment, create date and channel. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/shipments/merchant.

tools.name: channelengine_list_returns
tools.description: List returns for merchant orders, with filters on channel, order, status, date and acknowledgement. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/returns/merchant.

tools.name: channelengine_list_cancellations
tools.description: List order cancellations for this merchant, with filters on creation date and order numbers. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/cancellations/merchant.

tools.name: channelengine_list_notifications
tools.description: List notifications ChannelEngine raised for this merchant (for example order or shipment problems), with date and order filters. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/notifications.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: channelengine_list_notifications · Public sink: channelengine_acknowledge_order, channelengine_update_stock.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: channelengine_list_notifications · Public sink: channelengine_acknowledge_order, channelengine_update_stock

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
